name: Grinning Heart: The Voyage
source:
The story begins with a dragon who lost in a cursed woods over hundred years. He wants to get out from there and come back to his tribe so badly.
And Suddenly, a traveler with unexpected circumstance, come to his life.
The traveler true self was a famous handsome-man hunter, person who go around the world to take handsome-man's photographs. And she was also lost in there.
The traveler was trying to get his picture, and the dragon was trying to eat her, while both of them hiding their true identity for each other...
translation:
故事开始于一条在被诅咒的森林中迷失了数百年的龙。他非常想离开那里，回到他的部落。
突然，一位旅行者带着意想不到的情况来到了他的生活中。
旅行者真身是一位著名的帅哥猎手，专门走遍世界各地拍摄帅哥照片的人。而她也迷失在了那里。
旅人试图拍到自己的照片，巨龙则想吃掉她，两人都互相隐藏着自己的真实身份……
